acceptanceCriteria: An operator can open an Audit title and read its findings, rulings, remediation artifacts, and current lifecycle state.
The UI distinguishes agent-recorded completion from human-only verification and closure actions.
The UI exposes the applicable human verification action when the workflow permits it.
component: Cross-Sprint integration, evidence collation, runtime-state classification, and final remediation record.
componentsAffected: Expose canonical Audit findings, rulings, remediation artifacts, and lifecycle state in AgileCockpit Metrics and Audit.
Provide drill-down views and permitted human verification actions without granting agent closure authority.
notes: Do not invent Audit findings or rulings when canonical state has none.
rationale:
The 20260827 Audit remediation spans many Sprints, and its rulings need one integrated verification pass before the cycle can be reported complete. This task confirms all 21 unresolved rulings and I-0031 have linked evidence, that diagnostics and affected test suites pass, and that projections and consistency checks are clean.

Constraint: Do not close the Audit cycle; closure remains human-only.
testSteps: UI and workflow tests covering findings, rulings, evidence, and human-only actions.

workItem.title: Make Audit findings, rulings, evidence, and verification actionable
